blocks.text: Gestionale Appuntamenti ("we", "our" or "us") operates the Gestionale Appuntamenti web and mobile application ("Service"), available as a Progressive Web App (PWA) and through the Google Play Store and Samsung Galaxy Store. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service and the choices you have regarding such data.
2.1 Types of Data Collected
We collect different types of information for various purposes to provide you with a better service:

items.text: name, email address, phone number, address
browser information, IP addresses, pages visited
billing information processed securely through Stripe and PayPal
contacts imported from Google Contacts or CSV files, with the user's explicit consent
push subscription tokens for sending appointment reminders

blocks.text: 2.2 Use of Data
We use the collected data to:

items: Provide and maintain the Service
Notify you about changes to our Service
Send appointment reminders via push notifications, email and WhatsApp
Allow you to participate in interactive features
Provide customer support
Gather analytics to improve the Service
Monitor the usage of the Service
Generate invoices and manage payments
Generate personalized QR Codes for quick client access
Detect, prevent and address fraud and security issues

blocks.text: The Service uses push notifications to send appointment reminders. To enable this feature, your browser or device will request your explicit consent. We collect a push subscription token that is used exclusively for sending notifications. You can disable push notifications at any time from your browser or device settings.

The Service allows professionals to send reminders and communications to clients via WhatsApp. Messages are sent using the phone number provided by the client. We do not share phone numbers with third parties. Messages are sent through direct WhatsApp links and not through third-party APIs.
When you authorize synchronization with Google Calendar, we collect and store:

items: OAuth access tokens to access your calendar
The appointments you choose to synchronize
Calendar event information (title, time, participants)

blocks.text: This data is used exclusively to synchronize appointments with your Google Calendar. You can revoke access at any time from your Google account settings.

The Service allows you to import contacts from Google Contacts (via OAuth authorization) or from CSV files. Import only occurs upon explicit user request. Imported contacts are stored in the Service database and are visible only to the professional who imported them. We do not share imported contact data with third parties.
The Service generates personalized QR Codes to allow clients quick access to their personal area. QR Codes contain a unique client identifier and do not include sensitive personal data.
The security of your data is important to us. We adopt the following protection measures:

items: Encryption of sensitive data (passwords, tokens)
Multi-tenant isolation: each professional's data is separate and inaccessible to other users
HTTPS connections for all communications
Payments processed securely through Stripe and PayPal (we do not store credit card data)

blocks.text: No method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

We use session cookies to identify you and remember your preferences. We do not use advertising tracking cookies. The Service is completely ad-free. You can disable cookies through your browser settings.
The Service uses the following third-party services:

items.text: for authentication and synchronization with Google Calendar and Contacts
for sending notification and confirmation emails

blocks.text: Each third-party service has its own privacy policy. We encourage you to review their respective policies.
In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to:

items: Access your personal data
Correct inaccurate data
Request the deletion of your data
Object to the processing of your data
Restrict processing
Request data portability
Withdraw consent at any time

blocks.text: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide you with the Service. When you delete your account, your data is permanently removed from our system. The professional can delete their clients' data at any time from the management area.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at the support email address provided in your account.
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

techSavvy.q: Do I need to be tech-savvy?
techSavvy.a: No. The app is designed for people with little time who want simplicity. You are up and running in 10 minutes. If you have questions, our support responds within 24 hours.

dataSafe.q: Are my data and my clients' data safe?
dataSafe.a: Yes. Data is stored on European servers, encrypted and GDPR-compliant. Consent forms for your clients are also included.

offline.q: Does it work without an internet connection?
offline.a: The PWA lets you view your schedule offline. An internet connection is required to make changes and receive updates.

freeTrial.q: Can I try it for free?
freeTrial.a: Yes, 40 days free with no credit card required. No automatic charges at the end of the trial.

staff.q: Can I also manage my staff?
staff.a: Yes. You can add collaborators, assign appointments and view their schedules in a single screen.
